coreMemory.english: n. the way people or things are connected
coreMemory.structure: build a relationship /bɪld ə rɪˈleɪʃənʃɪp/（建立关系）；close relationship /kloʊs rɪˈleɪʃənʃɪp/（亲密关系）；relationship between /rɪˈleɪʃənʃɪp bɪtwin/（……之间的关系）；working relationship /wɝkɪŋ rɪˈleɪʃənʃɪp/（工作关系）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use relationship with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of relationship in context；❌ translate relationship word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “build a relationship”

commonErrors.wrong: use relationship with the same article in every context

commonErrors.right: check the countability of relationship in context
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /tʃɛk ðə countability ʌv rɪˈleɪʃənʃɪp ɪn kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.note: 同一个名词在不同义项下可能有可数、不可数或单复数差异，不能机械套用冠词。

commonErrors.right: learn the complete phrase “build a relationship”
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /lɝn ðə kəmplit freɪz bɪld ə rɪˈleɪʃənʃɪp/
commonErrors.note: 不要只按中文逐字替换；优先把本卡高频搭配作为完整句块记忆。
